name: Procedural Cloud Generation
aliases: Gabor and Gaussian Kernel Cloud Generation
definition: A strategy for procedural generation of clouds using Gaussian and Gabor kernels on cloud chunk surfaces to represent cores, splittings, and wispy effects.
summary: Procedural Cloud Generation synthesizes volumetric clouds using hierarchical Gaussian and Gabor kernels to model microstructure and wind-induced wisps without manual sculpting.
